verdict.rationale: A tax authority could plausibly publish bulk statistics or dataset downloads, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any downloadable dataset, extract, or statistics file from HMRC. The items cover account sign-up and registration pages, a Making Tax Digital filing API, and email subscriptions. VAT threshold figures written on a guidance page are not a bulk data download.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
